messages:
maria.g: Heads-up — planning to turn on the SDK-side shim for structured-output/fncall compat next week. Want to align on canary audiences and safety gates.
kevin: Which flag name are we using server-side? need to update the client docs and feature matrix.
maria.g: server toggle is `features.so_fncall_compat_v1` (default off). client exposes `enableSoCompat` in sdk v3.2.0. plan: enable server flag for 2% of traffic, client opt-in for dev builds only to start.
ben: 2% sounds fine. what metrics are we watching? latency, error rate, and any regressions in caller apps?
natalie: add model-level fallbacks too — if the new path exceeds p99 latency or error rate spike >2x baseline, auto-disable. recommend telemetry: p50/p95/p99 latency, qps, 500/502/timeout counts, and "missing-call" rate from structured-output evals.
ryan: also add a quality regression metric: prompt-set evals scoring function-call accuracy + schema conformance. if accuracy drops >3% we pause.
maria.g: agree. timeline: monday deploy server flag with audit-only mode (no routing change). tuesday enable for 0.5% as smoke. wednesday to 2% and flip client dev builds. thursday expand audience if green.
kevin: who owns the client rollout PR? i can review but need the patch link.
maria.g: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/sdk/pulls/876 — diff is minimal: adds opt-in param and telemetry hook. @kevin please review by EOD friday.
ben: quick ask — how do we mark experiments in the console? need an entry so growth has visibility.
natalie: i'll create a console note under "In-progress experiments" with the link and guardrails. also adding the auto-disable condition as a policy.
ryan: small config snippet for ops team:
```
feature_flag:
  name: features.so_fncall_compat_v1
  audience: 0.005 -> 0.02
  conditions:
    - metric: p99_latency
      threshold_ms: 1200
    - metric: error_rate
      increase_pct: 100
    - metric: structured_call_accuracy
      decrease_pct: 3
  actions:
    - mode: audit
    - mode: active
```
kevin: one more — client behavior: when shim is enabled but server doesn't support so, what should client do? fallback to old codepath or surface an error?
maria.g: client should fallback silently to legacy output and emit a diagnostic event. no hard errors in GA. for dev builds we can surface a warning in console.
ben: ops: when you open the canary, please tag pager duty runbook `so-compat` and route alerts to infra-oncall + eng-platform.
deploy-bot: deploy created: flag-service v3.4.2 -> staging (pipeline 4521). link: https://ci.internal/builds/4521 :white_check_mark:
maria.g: thanks. next steps: kevin review PR, natalie create console note, ops open canary and monitor the three buckets. i'll post a short post-mortem template so teams can report anomalies.
kevin: reviewing now. if i don't finish i'll leave inline comments.
natalie: created the console entry and added a short explainer for support. ping me for messaging to customers.
ryan: i'll wire up the regression eval and add a scheduled job to run the call-schema tests every 30m for the canary audience.
maria.g: perfect. if anything blocks the Friday review we push the smoke by 48h. otherwise proceeding with monday audit deploy. :thumbsup:
